result.title: VerdictAD: Few-Shot Anomaly Detection via Decision-Guided Refinement
result.comment: Preprint with 5 tables and 7 figures. Code and experimental logs available at https://github.com/sgstq0811/VerdictAD-Jev-AD
result.summary: Detecting defects in real-world industrial inspection often requires learning from only a few normal images per category. Recent few-shot anomaly detection methods have achieved strong performance by measuring feature differences between query images and normal references. However, visual differences do not always indicate genuine defects, as normal appearance variations can also produce high anomaly scores. Conversely, structural or logical anomalies may not produce strong local feature differences, making them difficult to detect. To address this limitation, we introduce VerdictAD, a training-free framework that refines existing anomaly detectors through visual decisions. Rather than replacing existing detectors, VerdictAD adopts a typed decision model to assess the query image and its local regions against a few normal references. By directly producing structured decision probabilities without text generation, the model provides complementary evidence for refining anomaly responses at different spatial scales. Building on this capability, we introduce two modules: Global Verdict Refinement (GVR) uses image-level decisions to refine the overall anomaly score, while Local Verdict Refinement (LVR) aggregates regional decisions to refine the anomaly map. Combined with a simple DINOv2-based detector, VerdictAD achieves competitive performance in one-shot and few-shot anomaly detection. More importantly, as a plug-and-play framework, it consistently improves existing anomaly detectors across MVTec AD, VisA, and MVTec LOCO AD, achieving strong results across one-shot and few-shot settings. Our code and experimental logs are publicly available at https://github.com/sgstq0811/VerdictAD-Jev-AD.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的 VerdictAD 框架，用类型化决策模型对查询图像及局部区域给出结构化判定概率，在全局与局部两尺度上修正现有少样本工业异常检测器的异常分数。
AI.relevance_reason: 题目中的「LVR」指 Local Verdict Refinement，与 latent visual reasoning 无关，方法只是在特征差异基础上加一个判别式打分修正头，没有推理状态生成、证据获取或多步决策过程，与视觉推理主线缺少实质联系。
